Public audit fixture <![CDATA[Samsung Launches Odyssey G6: The World’s First 1,100Hz Gaming Monitor]]> https://news.samsung.com/global/samsung-launches-odyssey-g6-the-worlds-first-1100hz-gaming-monitor Mon, 23 Nov 2026 22:00:00 +0000 https://bit.ly/4zOakzT

Samsung Electronics today announced the launch of the 27-inch Odyssey G6 (G60H), the world’s first gaming monitor to support a refresh rate of up to 1,100Hz in HD. The monitor also features Dual Mode, which allows players to choose between HD at up to 1,100Hz and QHD at up to 600Hz to suit their game and preferred play style.1

The Odyssey G6 is designed for fast-paced gaming, where players need to track movement and respond quickly. Its Fast IPS panel combines high refresh rates with a 1ms gray-to-gray (GtG) response time, helping reduce motion blur and deliver smoother on-screen action.

“With the Odyssey G6, we are bringing together an ultra-high refresh rate and enhanced motion clarity, while enabling gamers to toggle between display modes depending on their gaming preferences,” said Hun Lee, Executive Vice President of Visual Display (VD) Business at Samsung Electronics. “We will continue to advance display technology to make the gaming experience more immersive.”

Speed and Clarity for Competitive Play

Dual Mode lets players select the refresh rate that suits the game by simply switching resolutions for a more flexible and optimized gaming experience. Whether a gamer needs high resolution for an immersive open world game, or a faster refresh rate for a first-person shooter, Dual Mode offers easy switching based on preference. In HD mode, the monitor reaches up to 1,100Hz for fast-moving scenes, while in QHD mode, it offers a sharper 2,560 x 1,440 resolution with up to 600Hz.

The Odyssey G6 also introduces Odyssey Clear Motion, a feature that reduces motion blur to help players see fast-moving action more clearly during critical moments in gameplay. Through the optimized blur reduction algorithm, the Odyssey G6 keeps fast-changing scenes clear and crisp. Following its introduction on the Odyssey G6, Samsung plans to bring Odyssey Clear Motion to more gaming monitor models.

Smooth Gameplay and Detailed HDR Visuals

The Odyssey G6 supports Samsung’s HDR10+ GAMING, which optimizes brightness and contrast in real time to deliver enhanced visuals in both bright and dark scenes.2 Black Equalizer also makes details in darker scenes easier to see by adjusting lower luminance levels, while automatically adapting to the game genre for an optimal gaming experience.

Support for NVIDIA G-SYNC compatibility and AMD FreeSync Premium helps reduce choppiness, screen tearing, and stuttering for smoother gameplay when used with compatible graphics cards.

Connectivity Designed for Convenience

Crystal clear picture quality is supported by advanced connectivity options. With one DisplayPort 2.1 port and two HDMI 2.1 ports, the Odyssey G6 offers connections for multiple devices. Auto Source Switch+ detects a newly connected source so players can switch inputs without manually cycling through them. The convenient experience is enhanced by the premium, ergonomic design of the Odyssey G6. Players can adjust swivel, tilt, and pivot angles, as well as height, to suit their own gaming setups.

The Odyssey G6 builds on Samsung’s leadership in the global gaming monitor market, which it has held for seven consecutive years, from 2019 through 2025.3

Availability, pricing, and launch timing vary by market. For more information, please visit Samsung.com.

  1. macOS does not support Dual Mode or the native maximum refresh rate of 600Hz. Refresh rate may vary based on supported game content and input source performance. ︎
  2. HDR10+ GAMING is compatible with HDMI 2.1 cables connected to the HDMI ports of NVIDIA and Intel GPUs. List of supported GPUs available here. Functionality may be limited depending on PC specifications and cable standards. Compatible with specific game titles only; see here. ︎
  3. Source: IDC Quarterly PC Monitor Tracker, Q4 2025, based on value amount. Global No. 1 gaming monitor brand from 2019 to 2025. ︎
